notes:
- Discord sign-in now uses a redirect Discord actually accepts: Discord's developer portal only accepts https:// redirect URIs for a standard (non-Social-SDK) OAuth2 application, so the discord-<app id> scheme from 2.1.5 still failed. The redirect is now an https URL on GitHub Pages that forwards the callback to the app's anisequel://discord scheme. Enable GitHub Pages (Settings -> Pages, source main /docs) and register https://orintarotsumugi.github.io/AniSequel/discord-callback.html in the Discord portal for application 1571747436542566561.
- The sign-in still works on an older build mid-flight: The legacy anisequel://discord filter and parser stay registered, and the parser also accepts the Social-SDK discord-<app id> form and the https callback, so a redirect already in flight on any recent build still resolves instead of being dropped.
